page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.48xlarge is a memory-optimized instance designed for enterprise applications that demand substantial memory footprint and parallel processing power. Based on the x86_64 architecture and deployed on the KVM hypervisor, the instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at 3.2 GHz. It provides 192 dedicated vCPUs paired with 1536.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 8.0 GB of memory per core.

The instance does not include integrated GPUs or local instance storage, requiring persistent workloads to utilize external network-attached storage volumes. To support heavy data movement and storage traffic across network interfaces, it is equipped with a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Delivering 192 dedicated compute cores and over 1.5 TB of memory in a single virtual machine provides high resource density, simplifying management by avoiding horizontal partitioning for large memory pools, though storage performance remains bound to network volume configurations.

Given its hardware specifications, ecs.r9i.48xlarge is suitable for memory-intensive enterprise environments. Primary operational fits include large-scale in-memory databases, distributed caching systems such as Redis, big data processing engines, and high-throughput transaction processing backends that require large memory pools alongside high core counts.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.48xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance designed for high-density enterprise workloads. Powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor clocked at 3.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture and KVM hypervisor, it features 192 dedicated vCPUs and 1536.0 GB of system RAM, providing an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. The configuration includes no local storage and zero GPUs, requiring reliance on external storage architectures while supplying 64 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth to support intensive interconnect and network storage throughput. The high compute and memory capacity enables substantial resource consolidation without multi-node distribution overhead. Consequently, ecs.r9i.48xlarge is well tailored for enterprise in-memory databases, massive in-memory caching systems, real-time analytics engines, and multithreaded corporate application backends.
